fact: NITDA's National Data Strategy to 2030 is marked Draft 2022 and carries a ministerial directive from the Minister of Communications and Digital Economy; its timetable has the governance structure and a strategy implementation committee still to be established from November and December 2022; the month is inferred from the upload path.

President Buhari unveiled and launched the National Data Policy at the State House, Abuja, on 2 February 2023, one of two policies developed by the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy and, per the Minister, earlier approved by the Federal Executive Council.

The Permanent Secretary of the Federal Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy said on 19 July 2023 that the government had officially launched the National Data Strategy, built on seven pillars; the article also says it was launched in March of the previous year, so the event date used is the article's.
NITDA's Director-General inaugurated a Technical Working Group on 19 July 2023 for the implementation of the National Data Strategy, to recommend how regulatory agencies implement it.
